subtitle: Classic backgammon, no ads
promoText: Play backgammon vs the computer or pass-and-play with a friend. No account, no ads.
description:
Backgammon Mastermind is a polished take on the classic strategy board game.

Jump straight into a match against the computer or share the board with a friend in pass-and-play mode. Roll dice, move your checkers, hit blots, and bear off all fifteen to win.

New to backgammon? Turn on move hints, point numbers, and the direction overlay to see exactly where you can play — the board teaches you as you go.

Features:
• vs Computer with heuristic AI
• Local 2-player (pass-and-play)
• Drag or tap to move; legal destinations highlighted
• Move hints, point numbers, and direction overlay for newer players
• Replay and review any turn of your game
• Fully localized — every App Store language
• No account and no ads — gameplay runs on your device

One purchase. Play offline after download. Perfect for sharpening your skills.
releaseNotes: First App Store release: play backgammon vs the computer or pass-and-play, with move hints, turn replay, and privacy-friendly analytics to improve the product.
